svg.title: Concept 3 sketch: ledger wordmark with total rule
svg.desc: SKETCH ONLY: type is live text in Newsreader with a serif fallback; the final wordmark is outlined paths. Left: square monogram, D and P over the accounting double rule. Right: the lockup. "Desert Peak" sits above a heavy rule and a hairline (the closed-total rule of a ledger) with INSURANCE letterspaced beneath, so the name reads as the sum and the word beneath as what it adds up to.

g.font-family: Newsreader, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
